paite: Pathian aw, Zion ah phatna in hon ngak nilouh hi, thuchiam na kiang ah tangtungsak in.
heading: David La / Phatna La Leh Kipahthu Genna

paite: Thumna zapa aw, na kiang ah sa tengteng ahong pai ding hi.
Thulimlouhnate'n hon zoh chiang in, ka tatleknate uh nang na silsiang hi.
Mi, na tempul huangsung intual a om thei ding a na tel a, na kiang na naihsak in nuam asa hi; na inn hoihna in ka tai ding uh, na tempul siangthou hoihna in.
Pathian hon hondampa aw, diktatna mulkimhuai thilhihte in na hon dawng ding hi; nang kawlmong a mi tengteng leh tuipi tung a gamlapi a omte lametna na hi.
Thilhihtheihna atai a kigak a, nangmah hatna a mualte hihkippa na hi hi.
Tuipi thawm ging, akihot gingte leh michih chiak vengvung hihdaipa na hi.
Kawlmong tawp a omte'n leng na theihsaknate alau ua; zingsang leh nitak paikhiaknate nuam in na kikousak hi.
Lei na veh a, tui in na khai a, nakpi petmah in na hihhoih hi; Pathian luitui in adim a, lei huchibang a na bawl nung in amaute a ding in buh na bawlsak hi.
Leilehte tui tampi in na vak a; asaichian na khengsak hi; vuahtui in na nemsak a, athilpoute na vualzawl zel hi.
Na hoihna in kum na khusak a; na paina lampite'n kiningchinna aluanglet hi.
Gamdai a gantatna munte ah aluanglet a, mual neute leng nopna toh akigaksuak uhi.
Gantatna munte ganhon in aluahsuak a; phaizangte leng buh in akhuh suak hi; nuam in akikou ua, la asa uhi.
